resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and the Clearwater list place Ranger Peak in the Clearwater National Forest; Idaho Fire Lookouts names the Nez Perce National Forest and files the peak under a Selway region label. The story uses the Clearwater name and says the sources differ.
firelookout.com marks the 1960s date with a question mark, Idaho Fire Lookouts says 1960s with the date unknown, and the Clearwater list gives 1960s. The story presents the 1960s as uncertain.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No source gives a staffing history, a fire, or a description of the site today. The Gone status rests on the Forest Fire Lookout Association list alone; the two lookout-site pages give no status. The build date is uncertain throughout. The Clearwater list draws partly on Rex Kamstra's firelookout.com site, so it is not independent of source 1. Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the site as hike-in; no source says whether visitors are allowed. Follow-up: Clearwater National Forest Ranger District or Powell Ranger Station records, and Ray Kresek's book Fire Lookouts of the Northwest, which the Clearwater list cites but which was not checked. The brief's kind 'unknown' is left as is.
